name: Spectral Bottleneck Attention Net (SBANet)
tagline: Per-block hard FFT bottleneck (low-rank rFFT-projection) with input-adaptive frequency gating, followed by temporal self-attention.

key_hyperparams.name: bottleneck_ratio
key_hyperparams.role: low-rank compression ratio in spectral bottleneck

diff_from_baseline: Vs DLinear/TimesNet/PatchTST baselines: builds an encoder-only stack where each block does rFFT → real/imag low-rank Linear-GELU compression (n_freq → k → n_freq) → multiply by adaptive σ(MLP(|X(f)|)) gate → iRFFT (no skip), then MHA+FFN with skip; instance-normalized in/out. The hard spectral bottleneck plus adaptive gate is the novelty — DLinear is decomposed-linear, TimesNet uses inception over period-folded 2D, PatchTST is patch attention.

name: VQ-VAE Memory-Augmented AE
tagline: Conv encoder → Transformer → vector-quantized codebook with EMA updates → Conv decoder; Gaussian denoising during training.

key_hyperparams.name: commitment_cost
key_hyperparams.role: VQ commitment weight (not added to loss)

diff_from_baseline: Vs DLinear/TimesNet/PatchTST: introduces a vector-quantization memory layer between encoder and decoder; nearest of K=32 codes is selected and gradient is straight-through; codebook updated by EMA (not gradient). Adds Gaussian denoising during training. Note: commitment loss is computed but cannot be added to the framework loss, so VQ is essentially used as a discrete information bottleneck.

name: Dual-Branch Masked Reconstruction
tagline: Temporal-branch (patch-masked along time) and variate-branch (channel-masked) Transformers, fused per-variate by learnable α.

nodes.label: Temporal branch: patch-mask + sin PE + Tx
Variate branch: var-mask + learn PE + Tx

key_hyperparams.name: patch_len
key_hyperparams.role: size of contiguous time patches in temporal mask

key_hyperparams.name: mask_p_t
key_hyperparams.role: Bernoulli prob of masking a temporal patch

key_hyperparams.name: mask_p_v
key_hyperparams.role: Bernoulli prob of masking a variate

diff_from_baseline: Vs DLinear/TimesNet/PatchTST: uses TWO transformer encoders in parallel — a temporal-axis branch with patch masking (length-10 patches at 0.4 prob) and a variate-axis branch (one token per channel, mask 0.4 of channels), each replacing masked tokens with a learned [MASK]; outputs are recombined per variate via a learnable α. Reconstruction is computed as α·temporal + (1-α)·variate, then de-normalized.

name: Frequency-Balanced Dual-Path (FBDPR)
tagline: AvgPool-decomposes signal into trend/band/detail; depthwise+pointwise convs per-band, soft-shrunk detail, FFT-energy gating, channel-mix context.

key_hyperparams.name: k_trend, k_mid
key_hyperparams.role: AvgPool kernel sizes for trend / mid bands

key_hyperparams.name: freq cuts
key_hyperparams.role: low/mid/high band split for energy gating

key_hyperparams.name: channel-context weight
key_hyperparams.role: scale of channel-mix context added to recon

diff_from_baseline: Vs DLinear (which only does seasonal/trend Linear) and TimesNet/PatchTST: explicitly decomposes via stacked AvgPool into trend/band/detail, applies separate depthwise+pointwise conv pipelines per band, and intentionally underfits detail by soft-thresholding (λ=0.12) and scaling by 0.85 so anomalies remain in the residual; FFT-energy of x conditions a per-band sigmoid gate that mixes the recon, plus a channel-mix MLP injects cross-channel context.
